name: YakYak — resolve target, patch or new episode, render, post

nodes.name: Input event
nodes.notes: POST here to start. Body: { target: {mode: patch|episode, campaignId?, campaignName?, movieId?}, importData?, changes, chatWebhookUrl? }

nodes.name: Resolve target
nodes.notes: Never import per run. Adopt the owned campaign by id or name; import only once as a fallback. patch → trailer/template (or pinned movieId); episode → next unrendered slot (new season when full).

nodes.name: Get scenes
nodes.notes: Current scene values — used by patch mode to map sceneNumber → id AND to skip no-op edits. (Episode mode: a fresh slot has no scenes; harmless.)

nodes.name: Apply changes
nodes.notes: patch: diff-aware update-scene-* (dialogue→subtitle→burn · story→image→movie→burn · …). episode: set-movie-metadata plot + gen-movie-screenplay.

nodes.name: Generation progress
nodes.notes: patch → get-movie-scene-progress (stage counts). episode → get-movie-progress (the movieScreenplay execution is the completion signal, as the web app does).

nodes.name: Export render
nodes.notes: Concat all scenes + soundtrack into the final movie. force:true guarantees a stitched output (and, in episode mode, drives any per-scene renders still finishing).

nodes.name: Post to chat
nodes.notes: Slack/Discord/Teams incoming webhooks all accept { text }. onError=continue: a missing/broken chatWebhookUrl must not kill the run after the render already succeeded.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { url: (($('Get movie').item.json.movie || $('Get movie').item.json).finalMovieUrl || ($('Get movie').item.json.movie || $('Get movie').item.json).soundtrackedMovieUrl), movieId: $('Resolve target').first().json.movieId, campaignId: $('Resolve target').first().json.campaignId, mode: $('Resolve target').first().json.mode, changed: $('Apply changes').first().json.changed } }}
